verdict.rationale: Meilisearch stores user documents and embeddings, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the pack documents deleting documents or indexes, retention periods, or purge controls. Self-hosting and tenant-token access scoping are adjacent features (deployment choice and read isolation), not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
